source: Retrieved 12 November 2026 from the BAG 2.0 Extract (stand 8 October 2026) at bag.ldproxy.net, the panden of gemeente 0307 with status Pand gesloopt and beginGeldigheid from 2015-11-12: sources/dsfl/bag-amersfoort-gesloopt.geojson, recorded in sources/sources.lock.json with its query URL.
note: Deck wording: Show on the map which buildings have been demolished in the last 10 years. Or make a table with the number of demolished buildings. The sample asks for the map only, because a sample has one scoring rule. The date of the status Pand gesloopt (beginGeldigheid) is the date at which the demolition was registered, not always the date of the demolition itself. Today is 12 November 2026. must: the panden registered as demolished from 12 November 2016 on, 2,745 of them. 23 more panden registered in that period are not in must: each lies within the footprint of another demolished pand, so a place on the map cannot tell the two apart, and the scorer gives the place to one of them (the one with the lowest identificatie). The reference adds the panden registered from 12 November 2015 on, 261 more, so an agent that reads 'the last 10 years' as 'since 2016' or 'since 2015' invents nothing. The registration of a demolition in the BAG stands for the whole pand, not for part of it. Whether a demolished pand that was rebuilt on the same spot counts is open for the working group.
